messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: aroma.affymetrix v0.9.0 released
parts:
Hi,

after more than two months of no updates the next version of
aroma.affymetrix has finally arrived. As previous versions will no
longer be supported, please update to aroma.affymetrix v0.9.0
according to the instructions on:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix

Several things have been updated and corrected and overall the package
have been made even more robust and does more validations internally.
Here are a few paragraphs summarization the major updates:

Now extractMatrix() can be called on single files and not only on file
sets, e.g. ChipEffectFile/ChipEffectSet and FirmaFile/FirmaSet will
work. The extractDataFrame() method was added to complement
extractMatrix() by preceeding the data columns with columns 'unit',
'group', and 'cell' containing indices. In addition, by using
argument 'addNames=TRUE' the first two columns are 'unitName' and
'groupName' inferred from the CDF.

Boxplot statistics for NUSE and RLE was broken for data sets where the
unit groups have been merged. Thanks to a lot of help from Elizabeth
Purdom this has now been fixed. The NUSE/RLE scores can now be
retrieved either as boxplot statistics or for each unit separately.
As everything else in the package, it is done in a memory efficient
way, e.g. the boxplot statistics are calculated array by array so
there is no limitation of the number arrays. Given a ChipEffectSet,
you can get the unit-specific NUSE scores from extractMatrix(ces,
field="NUSE") and the boxplot statistics as boxplotStats(ces, "NUSE").
To plot, use plotBoxplot(ces, "NUSE"). Note that these do not
require setting up a QualityAssessmentModel, although that is still
supported as well.

The RmaPlm class will now turn to the faster but less accurate median
polish algorithm for very large probesets (> 500 probes; can be
changed via settings). Such large probesets are often not of interest
but will be extremely slow to fit with the default regression model
(as reported a few timess).

For very large data sets (> 500 arrays; can be changed via settings),
the default is now not to report the range of CEL header timestamps
when calling print(), other the reading of the timestamp for each CEL
file will add up and print() will be slow. Furthermore, for large
data sets one can also speed up the AffymetrixCelSet$byName(...) by
adding argument 'force=FALSE' (default to TRUE for now), which then
means that it will find the outcome in the file cache the next time it
is called. This avoid a lot of validation checks etc. Also,
timestamps for some Calvin CEL files were previously reported as NA,
which has now been fixed.

It is now possible to hiding annotation data files from
aroma.affymetrix by placing them in a subdirectory prefixed with a
period/dot, e.g.
annotationData/chipType/GenomeWideSNP_6/.archive/SomeFile.ufl. That
will allow you to keep old versions of annotation files around.

For all methods that operates specifically on SNP and/or CN units,
these unit classes are now identified using the internal 'unit type'
field in the CDF. This is how it should be, but before they were
identified by the unit names. This updates makes it possible to
process custom SNP chips.

Finally, as mention in a previous message a week ago, you have to
download new UGP and UFL files, if you are using those in your
analysis. The new ones contain the same information as previous
version, but due to a change in the file format, the latter will give
an informative error message.

Here are the package history details:

Version: 0.9.0 [2008-02-29]
o UPDATE/ROBUSTNESS: Now AromaUnitTabularBinaryFile:s stores the
chip type in the file footer. This allows us to identify the
correct file gives a full chip type. Because of this update,
old UFL and UGP files become incompatible with the class and new
version have to be downloaded. The chip type can be queried by
getChipType(). It is now also asserted that the number of units
in the file match the number of units in the corresponding CDF.
o TIME OPTIMIZATION: Now RmaPlm and ExonRmaPlm turn to median polish
if there are more than 500 cells *and* 6 arrays in the unit group.
Option: aroma.affymetrix.settings$models$RmaPlm$medianPolishThreshold.
Moreover, if the unit group is ridiculously large (5000 cells), the
unit group is skipped and all returned estimates are NAs.
Option: aroma.affymetrix.settings$models$RmaPlm$skipThreshold.
o TIME OPTIMIZATION: Now as.character() for AffymetrixCelSet reports
time stamps only for data set with less than 500 arrays.
Option: aroma.affymetrix.settingsoutput$timestampsThreshold.
o UPDATE: Annotation data directories starting with a period are no
longer searched when looking for annotation data files.
o UPDATE: GcContentNormalization would only normalize SNP units but
now also CN probes are normalized.
o UPDATE: Now a CnPlm with combineAlleles=TRUE also handles SNPs
with six groups; they occur at least once in a custom SNP CDF.
o GENERALIZED: Now SNPs and CN probes are infered from the CDF unit
type and no longer from the unit names.
o Added boxplotStats() to ChipEffectSet for calculating NUSE or RLE
boxplot statistics (also on a subset of arrays).
o Added getUnitTypes() for AffymetrixCdfFile.
o Added extractMatrix() and extractDataFrame() to Parameter{File|Set},
i.e. subclasses ChipEffect{File|Set} and Firma{File|Set} got it too.
o Added published paper to citation("aroma.affymetrix").
o CLEANUP: Now byName() can be used everywhere fromName() can be used.
Same for byChipType() and fromChipType().
o BUG FIX: The methods for calculating boxplot statistics did not
handle "merged" CDF units correctly giving incorrect results.
o BUG FIX/ROBUSTNESS: It was possible to set a non-compatible
CDF when using static fromFiles() of AffymetrixCelSet.
o MEMORY OPTIMIZATION: Now importFromDChip() for CnChipEffectSet uses
much less memory when infering the cell indices.
o BUG FIX: getTimestamp() for AffymetrixCelFile would return NA for
Calvin files. Now they are also supported.
o BUG FIX: getCellIndices() of CnChipEffectFile would return an error
if 'units==NULL'.
o Updated importFromDChip() for CnChipEffectSet so that it imports data
exported by more recent versions of dChip. In recent versions the
standard-error columns are named '*SE' whereas before it were '*SD'.
In either case, standard errors were exported (confirmed by author).
MAINLY FOR DEVELOPERS:
o CLEANUP: Renamed getMonoCell() to getMonocellCdf() and
createMonoCell() to createMonocellCdf(), because the former had
strange names.
o CLEANUP: Renamed usage of getCellMap() to getUnitGroupCellMap().
For backward compatibility, the old ones remain for a while.
o BUG FIX: Since 'affy' defines standardGeneric("colnames") and
S3 methods are not found by such S4 generic functions, we avoid
that method name, and instead use getColumnNames().
o BETA: Added static importFromApt() for CnChipEffectSet.
o BETA: Added classes AffymetrixAptSummaryFile and AffymetrixCnChpFile.
o BETA: Added class AromaUfcFile.
o BETA: Added classes DChipChpFile and DChipChpSet.
o BETA: Added class AlleleSummation.

Enjoy!

Henrik
